install_metrics: install Prometheus and Grafana metrics servers to the METRICS_DIR directory
reinstall_metrics: cleanup, remove, and reinstall Prometheus and Grafana from scratch
view_metrics: launch Prometheus and Grafana servers and wait for CTRL-C to shutdown
cleanup_metrics: shut down persisted Prometheus and Grafana resources and stop running servers
remove_metrics: shut down and remove all Prometheus and Grafana files from the system
